mechanism: This is an evidence variant of the existing single-accent scale activation relay. Begin in a nearly neutral environment and isolate one original colored protection or aid object. Two clearly adult original people must complete one readable sharing, transfer or joint-use action before any environmental change. Start activation at the exact shared-contact zone, expand it through a visible monotonic boundary, and use repeated objects as intermediate scale relays before selected environmental accents change. Keep the original pair and object readable at the end. Do not copy source people, umbrellas, plaza, palette, watermark or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish a neutral environment and exactly one colored aid object.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple early colors make the signal origin ambiguous.

invariants.rule: Require two clearly adult original people to complete one sharing or joint-use action before activation.
invariants.purpose: Links world change to a human relationship event.
invariants.ablation_failure: An automatic color wave loses the interpersonal cause.

invariants.rule: Begin the change at the shared-contact zone and expand through one visible monotonic boundary.
invariants.ablation_failure: Scattered random recoloring breaks the relay.

invariants.rule: Use repeated surrounding objects as an intermediate scale before architecture or environment changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Jumping directly to city scale removes proof of transmission.

invariants.rule: End with the originating pair and aid object still readable inside the changed environment.
invariants.purpose: Returns the spectacle to its human cause.
invariants.ablation_failure: An anonymous wide forgets who initiated the change.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
